BiblicalUsage: On was an Israelite, the son of Peleth, of the tribe of Reuben, who joined Korah, Dathan and Abiram when they rose up against Moses and Aaron. His name appears only in the account of the rebellion, and nothing more is told of him.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe On is the warning of the crowd: he joined Korah's rebellion and his name is all that is left of him.
